prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.1% after noise correction across 4 tests with 2 wins, though 2 tests showed no clear effect.
Finish redesigns (finish, redesign) are helpful, averaging +2.4% after noise correction across 2 tests with 1 win, though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (adoption, new_screen; adoption, new_flow; adoption, redesign) with only 1 test each, all showing no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for path choice redesigns (choose_path, redesign) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.
Predictions are often too high, overestimating actual noise-corrected impact in most tests.
Predictions can sometimes underestimate actual impact, as seen in round 6 (+1.5% predicted vs +3.0% noise-corrected) and round 7 (+2.2% predicted vs +4.5% noise-corrected).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.1% after noise correction, 4 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 81.5%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.8%

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop companion layout for finish step: Redesign home_intro using a stage layout featuring pet interaction animations and visual launch instructions. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries (3-4 tickets) on desktop control confusion post-setup, and finish conversion is 71.0%.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen: Add a dedicated pet personality customization screen right after pick_friend to choose behavior traits and voice style. (why: Adoption has the lowest funnel conversion rate (60.9%), so adding early pet personality customization increases user investment.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign in after waiting state: Move sign-in to take place after pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Historical test evidence shows sign_in reordering averages +2.1% gain, and waiting step (median 201s) allows smooth background account linking.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet creation verification sub-flow: Insert a 2-step verification sub-flow (new_photo_check and new_pet_preview) before certificate generation to check pet rendering. (why: Support logged 3 tickets specifically about custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet birth progress tracker on waiting screen: Display granular multi-stage progress indicators during pet generation wait. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s) leading to abandonment prior to home launch.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account sync safety reassurance hint: Add prominent trust and sync callout text clarifying that sign-in preserves pet custom data across reinstalls. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Instant companion path clarity copy: Rewrite path selection headlines to highlight instant 10-second setup vs creative deep setup. (why: choose_path step conversion is 76.2% with a very long mean time of 514s, indicating decision hesitation.)
7: [choose_path, layout] Split path choice layout: Change choose_path layout to split layout with visual side-by-side comparison of quick start vs custom builder. (why: High mean time (514s) vs median (8s) shows split decision difficulty among new users.)
8: [home, notification] Desktop launch readiness notification: Add system notification toggle on waiting screen so users are notified when pet spawns on desktop. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app not opening after waiting.)
